rationale.org-governance: Contributes governance template with policies, audit, telemetry, and scanning guardrails.
rationale.ai-review: Deploys an AI reviewer in CI to comment on PR diffs.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Enforces SAST, SCA, and license scans on AI-generated code.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Requires explicit human approval for AI-generated code and ticket closures.
rationale.risk-routing: Uses an LLM triage classifier to prioritize and route bug tickets.
